decision: The owner (Han Qin) retired the hash-pinned binding chain of the Red Chamber first-eighty-chapter editions. Routine changes no longer add a binding layer; the current tree is checked directly.
retiredFromActivePaths: hongloumeng_english_pipeline.validate_standard_readiness no longer replays the B10 to Japanese-navigation predecessor layers.
build_hongloumeng_reading_english.production_plan no longer requires implementation hashes or binding and review record hashes.
The chapter49 reader-note overlay is called directly from hongloumeng_seven_character_binding, pinned to its own decision records, not through the chain.
hongloumeng_japanese_navigation_binding keeps only the exact reversible insertions and the Japanese reader gate.
currentChecks: Frozen Chinese source: READING_SHA, MANIFEST_SHA and BODY_SHA in hongloumeng_english_pipeline.load_source; build_hongloumeng_first80_traditional.py --check.
Frozen English standard: standard_snapshot() equals EXPECTED_NORMATIVE_SNAPSHOT, and every unit and batch review is current (validate_progress).
Approval: reading-publication.json must equal the data actually rendered (source, standard snapshot, progress, notes) plus its recorded first-generation date.
Japanese alignment: hongloumeng_japanese_pipeline validate/validate_partial, no source fallback, unique placeholder markers, one PARTIAL table for the builder, availability and notices.
Byte-identical outputs: the zh-Hans, zh-Hant, English and Japanese readers equal their builders; legacy-page Japanese navigation insertions are exactly reversible.

Tests: test_hongloumeng_current_state.py (new), test_hongloumeng_japanese_navigation_binding.py (rewritten), test_hongloumeng_reading_japanese.py, test_hongloumeng_partial_private.py, test_hongloumeng_japanese_pipeline.py, test_hongloumeng_reading_english.py, test_hongloumeng_reading.py.

archive.records: All binding, review, self-check, history and receipt records under data/hongloumeng/first80-english/ and data/hongloumeng/first80-japanese/ are unchanged and remain historical evidence. They are no longer replayed, and no earlier review is claimed for later changes.

verification.japaneseRebuild: build_hongloumeng_reading_japanese.py rewrote 84 files with no diff; hongloumeng_partial_private.py rewrote the placeholder index and 5 private partial pages with no diff.
verification.chapter49Overlay: Direct overlay result equals the former chain result.
verification.discoveryHubSearchSitemap: Not regenerated here: refresh_hongloumeng_reading_discovery.py needs macOS CoreFoundation for the Traditional hub converter. None of its inputs changed; run its --check on macOS to confirm.

timings.navigationTests: 14 tests in 23s before, 11 tests in 2s after
timings.englishNoteOverlay: 14s chain replay before, direct call after

historicalLayerTests.note: These tests check retired layers against the current tree. They already failed before this change because later layers changed their pinned files, and they stay byte-identical because producer layers pin some of them. They are not current checks.
historicalLayerTests.changedByThisRetirement: The chapter72, later-two-readings and seven-character layer tests each gain one error: the approval record no longer carries implementationHashes.

preexistingFailuresUnrelatedToThisChange: test_hongloumeng_first80_traditional.py expects 586250 characters; the current Traditional text has 586252.
test_hongloumeng_reading_traditional.py expects only zh-Hans, zh-Hant and x-default alternates; the pages also list en and ja.
test_hongloumeng_reading_english_anchors.py: one projected anchor differs (' Do tell me' vs 'Do tell me.').
test_hongloumeng_hub.py, test_hongloumeng_original.py, test_hongloumeng_readings.py: need macOS CoreFoundation.
build_hongloumeng_first80.py --check: untracked private review and audit files for chapters 44 and 49 are stale.
